steps.title: Open the default landing page
steps.narration: The default landing page now displays real direction words across all three Market state badges. Regime, Market phase, and Breadth all show 'little changed' instead of placeholder values.
steps.point_out: Notice the three direction badges in the Market state card all show real words, and the Summary card confirms the same condition.

steps.title: Navigate to full market context
steps.narration: The market context link takes you to a detailed market view showing regime and phase analysis, sectors, and themes for deeper understanding.
steps.point_out: The full market context page loaded, showing additional analysis tools beyond the quick summary on the homepage.

target.name: Full market context (regime × phase, sectors, themes)

steps.title: Compare with a previous date
steps.narration: A previous date shows different direction words, confirming that this update only affects the most current data snapshot and leaves historical records unchanged.
steps.point_out: The badges here show 'improving' instead of 'little changed', proving each date has its own independent snapshot.

steps.title: Verify older dates still load
steps.narration: Dates from two years ago load normally, showing that this change has no impact on historical data and the system remains fully backward compatible.
steps.point_out: The page renders normally for a date from two years ago, confirming no regression across the full historical range.
